title: Easy Grilled Australian Lamb Skewers
description: Grassy and tender Australian lamb skewers served with basmati rice, perfect for a crowd, and dairy-free-friendly, cooked to perfection on a robata-grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Meanwhile, cook the basmati rice according to package instructions.
Serve the lamb skewers with the cooked basmati rice and garnish with additional rosemary if desired.
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before serving.
